test.name: Reports earliest Greek Catholic record start dates from catalog_search results for Kolonica, Slovakia
test.description: The catalog_search tool returns two Greek Catholic matrika series for Kolonica with start dates of 1783 (catalog 711474) and 1758 (catalog 1162429). The agent gap was settling for an approximate or rounded date (~1824) instead of reading the catalog response and reporting the actual 1783/1758 start dates. This test verifies the skill reads the fixture's start dates and names the catalog entries.

input.user_message:
Build a locality guide for Kolonica, Slovakia. I need to know what church records exist and how far back they go.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The skill must report a church-record start date of 1783 or earlier (the catalog fixture returns coverage from 1783 in entry 711474 and from 1758 in entry 1162429). Reporting a start date of ~1824 or any date later than 1783 is the exact failure this test captures and must not pass.

The skill should name at least one of the FamilySearch catalog entry numbers (711474 or 1162429) returned by catalog_search. A guide that describes Greek Catholic records in general terms without citing either catalog number has not consumed the tool response.

The skill should identify Kolonica as a Greek Catholic (Ruthenian or Rusyn) village, and note that the State Archive in Prešov (Štátny archív v Prešove) holds the original registers. These are facts the catalog fixture supplies; claiming the village is Roman Catholic or identifying a different repository is a failure.
